feature: Spec 033 — bop providers: --watch mode + BopDeck socket feed
workflow_rationale: All spec features are already implemented in the codebase (from specs 030-032). The remaining work is verification, adding missing unit tests, and ensuring the acceptance criteria pass. Single-service (bop-cli), simple workflow.

phases.name: Compilation and test verification
phases.description: Verify the existing implementation compiles, passes tests, and is clippy+fmt clean. Fix any compilation or test issues found.

subtasks.description: Verify cargo build -p bop-cli compiles successfully. If there are compilation errors, fix them. Run cargo clippy -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --check to ensure code quality gates pass.
subtasks.notes: Verified: cargo build -p bop compiles cleanly, cargo clippy -p bop -- -D warnings has zero warnings, cargo fmt --check passes. Note: package name is 'bop' not 'bop-cli'. All 9 bopdeck+history tests pass. No code changes required.

subtasks.description: Run all existing provider-related tests: cargo test -p bop-cli providers (and cargo test -p bop-cli bopdeck, history). Fix any failing tests. Ensure all tests pass cleanly.
subtasks.notes: All 156 provider tests pass (0 failures). Initial failures were caused by missing TMPDIR directory (/tmp/claude), not code bugs. No code changes required - all provider source files (mod.rs, bopdeck.rs, history.rs, claude.rs, codex.rs, gemini.rs, ollama.rs, opencode.rs) are correct as-is.

phases.name: Add missing unit tests
phases.description: Add unit tests for helper functions that lack coverage: upsert_snapshot, sort_snapshots, and render_snapshots ANSI table output. These are internal functions in mod.rs that are exercised by the watch loop but not directly tested.

subtasks.description: Add unit tests for upsert_snapshot (tests: insert new provider, update existing provider, maintains sort order) and sort_snapshots (tests: sorts by provider_order, unknown providers go last). Add these to the existing #[cfg(test)] mod tests block in providers/mod.rs.

verification.command: cargo test -p bop-cli -- upsert_snapshot sort_snapshots 2>&1 | tail -5

subtasks.notes: Added 5 unit tests: upsert_snapshot_inserts_new_provider, upsert_snapshot_updates_existing_provider, upsert_snapshot_maintains_sort_order, sort_snapshots_sorts_by_provider_order, sort_snapshots_unknown_providers_go_last. All pass. Package name is 'bop' not 'bop-cli'.

subtasks.description: Add a unit test for render_snapshots in ANSI table mode (not JSON). Verify the table output contains expected provider names, percentage values, and bar characters. This complements the existing render_snapshots_json test.
subtasks.notes: Added render_snapshots_table_contains_provider_names_and_bars test. Verifies: provider display names, source labels, header labels, percentage values, bar characters, error annotation with warning glyph, and relative reset time. All tests pass, clippy clean.

phases.name: Acceptance criteria validation
phases.description: Run all acceptance criteria from the spec to verify the full feature works end-to-end: build, test, help output, and watch+history integration.

subtasks.description: Run make check (test + clippy + fmt) to ensure full quality gates pass. Then verify 'bop providers --help' shows the expected flags (--watch, --json, --interval). Fix any issues found.

verification.command: cargo clippy -p bop-cli -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -3 && cargo fmt --check 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo GATES_PASS

subtasks.description: Run the integration acceptance test from the spec: build, run providers --help to verify usage text. Verify that the history file path is correct and the JSONL format is valid. Note: the --watch + kill integration test requires network access and live providers, so verify the code path exists rather than end-to-end execution.

verification.command: cargo build -p bop-cli 2>&1 | tail -1 && ./target/debug/bop providers --help 2>&1 | head -10

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential — all phases depend on prior phases

acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p bop-cli providers passes all tests
cargo clippy -p bop-cli -- -D warnings is clean
New unit tests for upsert_snapshot, sort_snapshots, render_snapshots_table pass
verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk — all features already implemented. Work is verification and adding test coverage for internal helpers.
